title: Pantry Klandestin
theme: Menemukan kebebasan dan makna absurd dalam rutinitas kerja yang monoton melalui observasi jenaka terhadap keanehan rekan-rekan kerja.

cover.prompt: An environmental shot of an office pantry. Focus on a refrigerator door, prominently featuring a single, distinct sticky note placed gently. Other layered notes are subtly visible in the background on the fridge. Scattered crumbs on a clean countertop and an instant coffee jar are in the soft-focus distance, hinting at daily corporate routines. The atmosphere conveys subtle intrigue and the gentle absurdity of everyday office life. Diffused, soft morning light bathes the scene, rendered with a muted, clean color palette.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, muted color grading, gentle ambient light, minimalist composition focusing on objects.

meta.plan_summary: Seorang karyawan sinis menemukan catatan konyol di pantry kantor yang memicu observasi jenaka terhadap rekan-rekan kerja, mengungkap absurditas dan menemukan hiburan dalam kekonyolan rutinitas.
